title: Page 10
lines: “瞧得见吗？”斐然一手高举着她的灯笼，免得被人群给挤坏了。
“只看得见前面人头黑鸦鸦的……”身量不似他那般高身兆的尚善，在人群中挤得有些难受。
“跟我来。”
将尚善带出人群后，斐然找了个偏僻的角落，先让她变小后再抱着她跃至民家的屋顶上，接连跃过几间房子，最后来到了那座最靠近庙旁的一座大宅。他俩在宅顶上找好位子坐下，尚善拉开他身上厚重的衣袍躲进去取暖，他也把下巴搁在她的包子发髻上，一块儿津津有味地看着戏，也不管宅子的主人是否正在下头瞪着他们……
当晚他俩投宿在客栈，同躺在一张床上时，尚善还在回味着今日在镇上的所见所闻，她兴奋地挽着他的手臂道。
“明儿个我还要出门去玩。”
“……还想玩？”明日清早他们就该回山了，不然要是被清罡给逮到他们偷溜下山的话，那他们就惨了。
“嗯，上辈子有太多事都没有做过……”
斐然一怔，眼中顿时溢满温柔，“好，都依你。”
“咱们这样，算不算是同甘共苦、相依为命？”
“……算。”应该不会有比他们可悲的。
“往后的日子还长得很呢。”她幽幽叹口气，彷佛永远都看不到属于黎明破晓的那一阵曙光。
“再苦也有我陪着你。”他已经在想，既然这回他们都能收买两位真人了，日后只要继续收买那些老道士下去，说不定往后就都不必再吃素了？
数个时辰过去，当天边的晨曦才微微透亮，睡得正沉的尚善遭一记猛然的关门声给吓得醒过来，她惊魂未定的坐起身，才想看看到底发生了什么事，却一眼就先看到神色惨淡的斐然。
“刚刚……”她怔怔地一手指着房门。
“是清罡真人。”很不幸的，清罡真人找徒儿的速度，比他们想像的快上了许多。
斐然已是一副视死如归的模样。
“看见我俩衣衫不整的睡在一块儿的模样，可能误以为我已经把你给吃下腹，所以等我穿好衣裳，他应该就要过来收拾我了。”他冤啊，冤得都可以六月飞雪、七月飞霜了，就算清罡真人真要擅自定他这个罪，那也好歹先让他把她这个罪给犯了吧？
“我看破了，你记得到时帮我贴张清远真人的救命符。”横竖都是跳到黄河洗不清，那么该来的总是会来，该痛的……也一定会痛。
“你就安心去吧。”相当爱惜小命的尚善，决定只推他一人出去面对清罡的怒气。
“……”这个小没良心的。
带着壮烈的眼神，斐然打理好自己后，伸手推开寝房的门扇，颤巍巍地走向那个坐在花厅里喝茶的清罡真人。
“我能说句话吗？”
“别打脸。”
斐然的话尾一落下，清罡已起身将衣袍往两旁一振，自他袖中飞出的黄符，转眼间就已密密麻麻地将他包围。
他语气阴沉地道：“本道的徒儿……岂是你可染指的？”
外头早起的人们已开始在镇上行走或是交谈，明亮刺眼的朝阳也已晒进窗棂内，尚善这回没再去戳斐然，她蹲在他的身畔两手撑着下颔，无声赞叹着他那强韧的生命力。
斐然气若游丝地趴在地上，“我就剩下那么一口气……”
“行啦，有一口气就足够了。”她动作俐落地在他身上拍下一张清远为他特制的救命符。
“你呢？”感觉身上的力量正慢慢地恢复，他勉强地撑着身子坐起，“没事吧？清罡真人他有没有为难你？”
她摇摇头，“师父他说这全都是你的错。”
“他还说了什么？”
她字字详实地转述，“他说，你要是敢不负起责任来与我成亲，他会让你后悔曾来到世上过。”
“成亲就成亲！”哼，他还正愁找不到这个机会可跟清罡开口。
先行一步回到道观里的清罡，将他俩的事情上禀清远真人之后，就一直等着他们回来给他一个交代。
当斐然牵着尚善的手，堂堂正正地来到他的面前时，他的目光直落在他们交握的十指上。
“你俩愿成亲？”
“是！”斐然回得很痛快。
“那好，成亲后你俩生个孩子给本道。”清罡的下一句话就让他们愣掉了下巴。
“日后，那孩子就是本道的徒孙，本道会好好教养他，让他在日后成为一个合格的道家掌门人。”
对于尚善这个不爱修道的徒儿，他不敢指望她太多，可为了避免道家断在她这，他也只能把目光放在她的下一代上。经过他的估算，距离他得道成仙，约莫还有八十年的时间，他就不信，这一回花上八十年的时间，他会教不出一个成器的徒孙。
“不必了！”在有过尚善这个活生生、血淋淋的例子后，斐然说什么都不肯答应。
“嗯？”清罡冷目一凛，一张黄符已在眨眼间飞过去封住他的嘴巴。
“呜呜……”怎么撕都撕不下来？
“至于你们的成亲方式，就由本道来决定。”趁斐然还在忙着撕符纸，清罡再进一步地道。
尚善与斐然两人听得面面相觑……成亲还能分什么方式？
“本道……”清罡真人以一种意味深长的目光看着斐然，“定会为你妥善安排的。”
斐然总算搞清楚，清罡恶龙所说的成亲方式与安排……指的究竟是什么了。
只是，他到底该怎么向他大哥开口才好？
相隔不到两个月又再次回到皇爷府里，斐然坐在自己院子的大门门槛上，将十指深埋进浓密的黑发里，正满心苦恼着到底该怎么完成下山前清罡真人所交付给他的任务。
他与尚善的婚事，虽然清罡真人是勉强同意了，可清罡真人却也同时抛给了他一个很要命的难题。
准备再次前往厨房偷袭的尚善，在路过他身边时，很不讲义气地大力拍着他的肩。
“鼓起勇气，我看好你哟！”
“……”她说得简单，反正到时会被他大哥砍死的人又不是她。
刚自皇宫回来的斐思年，在准备回自己的院子里休息时，远远的就看到自家小弟又像个呆瓜般地坐在大门上，摆出那副打从他回府以来，就一直维持着时而忧郁时而烦恼的德行。
“你究竟是怎么了？”斐思年来到他的面前，实在是想不通有什么事可以令他困扰成这样。
“大哥……”斐然抬起头，眼中闪过一丝犹豫，但又很快地甩开，“我想问你件事。”算了，选日不如撞日，干脆就在今天豁出去了。
“我可以入赘吗？”
斐思年当下脚下一滑，差点就没能站稳，他难以置信地瞪着这个可能在山上吃素吃昏了头，脑袋还应该被门板给狠狠夹过的小弟。
“你再说一次？”这小子他疯了吗？他是什么身分？身为原国小皇帝倚重的臂膀、名扬天下的然公子，他居然……想、嫁、人？
斐然缩着颈子，怕怕地看着他眼底正蓄起的狂风暴雨。
“清罡真人说，我若要与善善在一起，我就得入赘至道观……”
斐思年一把提起他的衣领，再三确认地问。
“你可知这代表什么意思？你确定你真想清楚了？”虽然两情相悦是好事，但那并不代表什么都可以不计较了。
前有恶龙后有心爱的母老虎，斐然义无反顾地点点头。
“已经想得够清楚了。”都已被清罡真人格外用力的“照顾”那么多回了，他有胆子不答应吗？
content_en:
"Can you see it?" Feiran held her lantern high with one hand to prevent it from being crushed by the crowd.
"I can only see the head and the black crow in front of me..." Shang Shan, who was not as tall as him, felt a little uncomfortable in the crowd.
"Follow me."
After taking Shang Shan out of the crowd, Fei Ran found a remote corner, made her smaller first, and then jumped onto the roof of a house with her in his arms. He jumped over several houses in succession, and finally came to the big house closest to the temple. They found a seat on the roof of the house and sat down. Shang Shan pulled off his heavy robe and hid in to keep warm. He also put his chin on her bun and watched the show together with great interest, regardless of whether the owner of the house was staring at them from below...
That night when they stayed at the inn and lay on the same bed, Shang Shan was still thinking about what he had seen and heard in the town today, and she held his arm excitedly and said.
"I have to go out to play tomorrow."
"... Still want to play?" They should go back to the mountain early tomorrow morning, otherwise they would be in trouble if Qinggang caught them sneaking down the mountain.
"Well, there are so many things I haven't done in my previous life..."
Fei Ran was startled, and his eyes suddenly filled with tenderness, "Okay, it's all up to you."
"Does this mean we share joys and sorrows and depend on each other for life?"
"...Forget it." There should be no one more miserable than them.
"The days ahead are still very long." She sighed quietly, as if she would never see the first burst of dawn.
"No matter how hard it is, I will always be with you." He was already thinking that since they were able to bribe two real people this time, as long as they continue to bribe those old Taoist priests in the future, maybe they won't have to be vegetarian anymore?
A few hours passed, and the morning light became slightly brighter. Shang Shan, who was sleeping deeply, was startled to wake up by a sudden slam of the door. She sat up in shock and wanted to see what happened, but she saw the bleak-looking Fei Ran first.
"Just now..." She pointed blankly at the door.
"It's Master Qinggang." Unfortunately, Master Qinggang found a disciple much faster than they imagined.
"He..."
Fei Ran already looked as if he was ready to die.
"Seeing us sleeping together in disheveled clothes, he may have mistakenly thought that I had already eaten you, so when I put on my clothes, he should come to deal with me." He was unjust, so unjust that it would snow in June and frost in July. Even if Master Qinggang really wanted to convict him of this crime without authorization, then at least let him commit her crime first, right?
"You..."
"I've seen through it. Please remember to put up a life-saving charm for me when the time comes." No matter what, if you jump into the Yellow River to wash it away, then what should come will always come, and what should hurt... will definitely hurt.
"You can go with peace of mind." Shang Shan, who cherished his life very much, decided to push him out alone to face Qing Gang's anger.
"..." This little heartless guy.
With a majestic look in his eyes, after taking care of himself, Fei Ran stretched out his hand to push open the door of the bedroom, and walked tremblingly towards the Qinggang master who was sitting in the flower hall drinking tea.
"Can I say something?"
"Say."
"Don't slap me in the face."
As soon as Fei Ran finished his words, Qing Gang stood up and fluttered his robe to both sides. The yellow talisman flying out of his sleeves surrounded him densely in the blink of an eye.
He said in a gloomy tone: "A disciple of this Dao...isn't it yours to get involved with?"
People who got up early outside had begun to walk or talk in the town, and the bright and dazzling morning sun had also shone through the window lattice. Shang Shan did not poke Fei Ran this time. She squatted beside him and supported her chin with both hands, silently praising his strong vitality.
Fei Ran lay on the ground angrily, "I only have one breath left..."
"Okay, one breath is enough." She quickly took a photo of a life-saving charm Qingyuan specially made for him on his body.
"What about you?" Feeling that the strength in his body was slowly recovering, he reluctantly sat up, "Are you okay? Has Master Qinggang made things difficult for you?"
She shook her head, "Master said it was all your fault."
"What else did he say?"
She recounted it in detail, "He said, if you dare to irresponsibly marry me, he will make you regret ever coming to this world."
"If you get married, get married!" Huh, he was worried that he wouldn't find this opportunity to talk to Qing Gang.
Qinggang, who returned to the Taoist temple first, reported their affairs to Master Qingyuan, and then waited for them to come back and give him an explanation.
When Fei Ran took Shang Shan's hand and came to him openly, his eyes fell directly on their intertwined fingers.
"Are you two willing to get married?"
"Yes!" Feiran replied happily.
"Well, after you get married, you two will have a child for me." Qing Gang's next words made their jaws drop.
"What?!"
"In the future, that child will be our disciple. We will educate him well so that he can become a qualified Taoist leader in the future."
For Shang Shan, a disciple who didn't like to practice Taoism, he didn't dare to expect too much from her, but in order to prevent Taoism from ending with her, he could only focus on her next generation. After his estimation, it would take about eighty years before he could attain enlightenment and become an immortal. He did not believe that if it took him eighty years this time, he would not be able to teach a single disciple.
"No need!" After having a living and bloody example like Shang Shan, Fei Ran refused to agree to anything.
"Huh?" Qing Gang stared coldly, and a yellow talisman flew over to seal his mouth in the blink of an eye.
"Woooo..." I can't tear it off no matter how hard I try?
"As for the way you get married, it's up to you to decide." While Feiran was still busy tearing up the talisman paper, Qinggang said further.
Shang Shan and Fei Ran looked at each other in shock... What other ways could they get married?
"My way..." Master Qinggang looked at Fei Ran with a meaningful look, "I will make proper arrangements for you."
Feiran finally figured out what the marriage methods and arrangements mentioned by Qinggang Evil Dragon... meant.
But, how should he speak to his elder brother?
Less than two months later, he returned to the imperial palace again. Feiran sat on the threshold of his courtyard, burying his fingers deeply in his thick black hair, and was worried about how to complete the task assigned to him by Master Qinggang before going down the mountain.
Although Master Qinggang reluctantly agreed to his marriage to Shang Shan, Master Qinggang also threw him a fatal problem.
Shang Shan, who was about to go to the kitchen for another sneak attack, patted his shoulder very unfaithfully when he passed by.
"Have courage, I'm optimistic about you!"
"..." She said simply. Anyway, she was not the one who would be hacked to death by his elder brother.
Feisinian, who had just returned from the palace, was preparing to go back to his yard to rest when he saw his younger brother sitting on the gate like an idiot again from a distance, displaying the same demeanor that he had maintained since he returned home, sometimes melancholy and sometimes troubled.
"What's wrong with you?" Feisinian came to him and couldn't figure out what could bother him so much.
"Brother..." Fei Ran raised his head, a trace of hesitation flashed in his eyes, but he quickly shook it off, "I want to ask you something." Forget it, it's better to choose a day than to hit the sun, so let's just risk it today.
"Say."
"Can I get married?"
Feisinian's foot slipped immediately and he almost lost his balance. He stared in disbelief at this little brother who might have lost his head while eating vegetarian food on the mountain, and whose head should have been severely pinched by the door panel.
"Say it again?" Is this kid crazy? What is his identity? As Mr. Ran, the trusted arm of the young emperor of the original country and famous all over the world, he actually... wants to marry someone?
Feiran shrank his neck and looked fearfully at the storm building in his eyes.
"Master Qinggang said that if I want to be with Shanshan, I must enter the Taoist temple..."
Feisinian lifted up his collar and asked again and again to confirm.
"Do you know what this means? Are you sure you have really thought about it clearly?" Although it is a good thing for two people to be in love, it does not mean that you can ignore everything.
With the evil dragon in front of him and his beloved tigress behind him, Fei Ran nodded without hesitation.
"I've thought about it clearly enough." Master Qinggang has tried his best to "take care of" him so many times. Does he have the guts not to agree?
